args.description: pushes the invisible opponent he is holding forward with his free hand, then swings a huge jagged black greatsword with glowing red veins in a wide arc in front of him, the whole blade always drawn clearly, then returns to the ready stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no glow, no flash, no sparks, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground; the whole body, the weapon and any trail stay inside the picture.
args.subject_description: a young man with spiky black hair streaked with red, red eyes, a long red scarf, an open black and red coat over a bare chest, black trousers, red and black boots, holding a huge jagged black greatsword with glowing red veins
args.initial_pose: holding an invisible opponent in front of him with both hands
